about: Every human-readable string on Study 84's page, by data-copy id. Written by build.cjs from words.json (ours and the club's), personas.json (the brand guide), ../../sitemap/bet.json (the bet's questions) and concepts.json (where each is answered). pages = the options it shows on (a, b, c, d) or chrome. flag: draft = ours, set italic; label = ours, wayfinding; sourced = the club's words verbatim, set upright, see src; bet = the bet's question; chrome = round 4's nav, footer, next.

84.x.t.ask.text: What's their Tuesday night like without EWC?
84.x.t.ask.src: ewc/EWC workshopsession2fill.excalidraw (workshop 2, 22 Apr, part 2 "Who it's for"); Study 46 t.ask

84.a.s0.it.text: Nothing ever happens on a Tuesday.

84.a.s1.it.text: They had the value. They couldn't break it down. Most founders we meet have this.

84.x.f.a5.text: maybe EWC can serve as a way of breaking monotony

84.a.s2.it.text: It was already on their board. We just asked which night.

84.a.s3.it.text: The competition was never another club. It's whatever they'd do otherwise.

84.g.h.text: Six members, one Tuesday. Same few places.

84.h.hint.text: Hover a member to see more (tap on a phone).

84.data.p0.life.text: Two kids, 9 and 12. Soccer sideline, porch coffee, house project.

84.data.p0.w0.today.text: a coffeeshop near the house, or the office

84.data.p0.w2.today.text: the driving range, a lakefront patio

84.data.p0.w3.today.text: at home, a small private gym

84.data.p0.give.s0.text: The café, the lounge, the events space.

84.data.p0.give.s2.text: Featured chefs, poker nights, golf-focused pilates — and leagues that give you somewhere to go even when you don't have friends.

84.data.p1.life.text: Teens at home. 7:40 tee time, home by noon, lake with the kids. Already belongs somewhere.

84.data.p1.w2.today.text: a friend's house, a private room at Daniel's

84.data.p1.w3.today.text: a scheduled appointment with his wife

84.data.p1.give.s0.text: Bookings he can plan around — an 8am bay before work.

84.data.p1.give.s1.text: Demo days, whiskey launches, Bandon and Pebble.

84.data.p1.give.s2.text: Deliberately slower programming: visits over two hours.

84.data.p2.life.text: Grown kids, first grandchild. Two boards, one advisory role.

84.data.p2.give.s0.text: A named role and a real position in the club.

84.data.p2.give.s1.text: He organizes programming, recruits teams, hosts member dinners — and we say publicly that he is the one who made it happen.

84.data.p3.life.text: Newly married, no kids, a dog. New restaurant, one hike, Sunday work.

84.data.p3.w3.today.text: meetups, affinity groups, friends of friends

84.data.p3.give.s0.text: The lounge as workspace and as the default "meet me at."

84.data.p3.give.s1.text: A room mixed on purpose — professions, genders, backgrounds.

84.data.p3.give.s2.text: Events with the top Seattle companies, one-offs, short-format matches.

84.data.p4.life.text: Kids in their 20s. Long breakfast, garden, dinner with two other couples.

84.data.p4.w0.today.text: the arts centre, the mall, a purchase

84.data.p4.give.s0.text: Cohorts that start the game on the same day, so nobody is behind.

84.data.p4.give.s1.text: Leadership called out by name, and accolades worth winning.

84.data.p4.give.s2.text: Private space to book — book clubs, birthdays, corporate parties.

84.data.p5.life.text: Senior IC or top firm. Run, brunch, date night, side project.

84.data.p5.w2.today.text: a sports bar, the work text group

84.data.p5.give.s0.text: Guest passes, and the generosity of bringing people.

84.data.p5.give.s1.text: Athlete and brand nights, demo sessions, date nights worth choosing.

84.data.p5.give.s2.text: Faster programming — in and out in sixty to ninety minutes.

84.a.s4.it.text: Who you aim at, and with what, decides who walks in.

84.x.v.l4.text: Somewhere you never need an occasion to come in, only a reason to stay.

84.a.s5.it.text: Nobody joins a club out of fear.

84.a.s6.it.text: The problem solved, and the members they wanted.

84.x.f.a1.text: picking up kids and coming home, so they are busy, figuring out dinner

84.x.f.a2.text: going to a game, to a museum to have dinner with friends

84.x.f.a6.text: Probably EWC is a thing during the week "day" not week night

84.a.s7.it.text: A two-person team ran the interviews, and wrote the italics on this page.

84.a.s8.it.text: We picked Tuesday. Would you have solved it that way, and what's the Tuesday in yours?

84.bet.q.b1.f.text: What do they actually make, and could they make mine?

84.bet.q.b1.e.text: Do I feel clear after ten seconds, or tired?

84.bet.q.b1.i.text: Is this a place someone like me goes?

84.bet.q.b2.f.text: Have they worked on a problem shaped like mine?

84.bet.q.b2.e.text: Do I feel understood before I've explained anything?

84.bet.q.b2.i.text: Can I need this without feeling I've failed at my job?

84.bet.q.b3.f.text: What is staying stuck actually costing me?

84.bet.q.b3.e.text: Do I want to start now, from wanting and not from fear?

84.bet.q.b3.i.text: Am I someone who acts on this, or who says "when I have time"?

84.bet.q.b4.f.text: What did it do for them, at a size like mine?

84.bet.q.b4.e.text: Do I want mine to feel like that?

84.bet.q.b4.i.text: Would I be proud to sit next to this work?

84.bet.q.b5.f.text: What would they find that my team hasn't?

84.bet.q.b5.e.text: Do I feel excited by that, or exposed?

84.bet.q.b5.i.text: Do I come out looking smarter, or shown up?

84.bet.say.b6.text: I want those two in the room.

84.bet.q.b6.f.text: Who will I actually work with, and can they do all of it?

84.bet.q.b6.e.text: Would this be fun? Would I trust them with something tender?

84.bet.q.b6.i.text: Are they my kind of people?

84.bet.say.b7.text: I know what happens if I write.

84.bet.q.b7.f.text: What do I ask for, how long does it take, what does it cost?

84.bet.q.b7.e.text: Is writing safe, or will it turn into a pitch?

84.bet.q.b7.i.text: Can I write without having it all worked out?
